Collapse to single reminder per contract+type via ContractReminderService upsert methods
question: ContractReminderService.createOrUpdateExpiryReminder/createOrUpdateRenewalReminder assume ONE pending reminder per contract+type (find-any-pending, update its date). ContractLifecycleScheduler deliberately creates MULTIPLE reminders per contract+type at configurable day-before windows (default 30/15/7), documented in its javadoc and asserted by existing tests (shouldCreateRemindersForApproachingExpiry, shouldUseCustomReminderDays). Routing scheduler reminder creation through the service's single-upsert methods would collapse the 3 reminder windows into 1, a functional regression, not a fix. Should the fix (a) preserve the current multi-window reminder cadence and instead clean up/replace stale pending reminders left behind when a contract's end date changes (root-cause fix without behavior regression), or (b) collapse to one reminder per contract+type via the service's existing upsert methods as originally described, accepting the loss of the 30/15/7-day multi-window cadence?
